changelog:
Initial release of frontend-design skill.

- Provides a clear workflow for creating high-quality, conversion-focused frontend designs with strong visual direction.
- Sets strict agent rules to avoid generic AI aesthetics and ensure every design has a meaningful point of view.
- Outlines step-by-step process, from brand context checks to delivering polished, production-grade HTML/CSS/JS.
- Supports a range of project types: landing pages, dashboards, components, emails, and redesigns.
- Enforces practical guidelines for interactive behavior, file management, and accessibility.
- Includes detailed design archetypes to guide consistent, intentional styling.
summary: Build polished, conversion-aware frontends with strong visual taste, clear hierarchy, and production-grade HTML/CSS/JS. Landing pages, dashboards, components...
